package.description: This application scans for network interfaces and adapters installed in system and their monitoring. Detailed info for every interface is provided.

en-US.longDescription:
This application scans for network interfaces and adapters installed in system and their monitoring. Detailed info for every interface is provided.
Every interface monitor has simple statistics view and graphic display with time history.

Free to use for both private and commercial users.
en-US.name: MiTeC Network Meter
